scope: Real HTTP and Edge with synthetic isolated data; quick submission is intentionally unauthenticated; admin access uses pre-authenticated synthetic session.

results.name: filing configuration is editable and displayed on login, admin and quick pages
administrator date filter shows exactly the selected day, not older open tasks
wrong details are rejected and optional cookie is saved without roster or attendance
one-click all-present only fills, and late initial distinguishes check time and current status
current update preserves initial record and server audit marks the identity unverified
remembered identifiers restore on reload and can be explicitly forgotten
filing text is rendered safely and empty settings disappear on every page
default date switches at 08:00 while a manually selected date stays pinned (mocked server time)
grade class creation, scoped import and class permission interface
browser has no unexpected script or CSP errors
